g_policy.reason: The user opts in by tapping the card, and the offer copy states the reward and its size (60 minutes of priority routing). Declining ('Not now') leaves the app unchanged, and the ad-fails field gives a path for no game or an unverified play.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 60 minutes of queue priority, which has no cash value and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is opening the side menu after 5 or more days away, which is an app event and needs no chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal adds an optional boost and says it removes nothing free, so nothing users get free today is locked or capped.

g_brand_safety.reason: The card sits in the side menu drawer (s06), which is rated safe and counts as app chrome. It is not in the conversation and is not over a chat or unsafe screen.

c1_revealed_value.reason: Priority routing is a charged resource, listed as a Plus benefit in l4 / s14.e10 on the paywall, so the existing_anchor reward targets something the app charges for.

c2_evidence.reason: The claims about the app are supported: the paywall lists priority routing (s14.e10 / m2), the side menu has the upgrade banner (s06.e50), and exp1 shows replies finishing in about 92 s. The proposal also admits the measured plan was not recorded, and its other statements are predictions or its own new elements.

c3_spares_payers.reason: The card is shown only to free users and subscribers never see it, so paying users are not shown a slice of their own plan.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward expires after 60 minutes, so it is a time-limited sample and not lasting access. It also does not give away the plan's main benefit. Priority routing is already sold in Plus, so queue priority is not taken from others.

c5_moment.reason: The offer sits on a persistent surface the user chooses to open (the side menu) and does not interrupt any task.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn unit with the reward tied to the verified play (the ad-fails field covers an unconfirmed game), and the trigger is a detectable app event (side menu opened after an absence).

c7_specific.reason: It names the side-menu 'Upgrade to Janitor Plus' banner (s06.e50), the Plus priority-routing line (s14.e10) and the My Chats landing screen, so it is specific to this app.

other_concern: The 'back after 5+ days' trigger and the 3-day window depend on the app tracking last-active time, which the product model does not show. Whether free users actually get slower routing is unobserved, since the measured account's plan was not recorded.
